components.css: .ds-course { padding: 32px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--ink); font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; } .ds-course h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.33; } .ds-course p { margin: 0 0 24px; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-course ul { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px 24px; margin: 0; padding: 24px 0 0; border-top: 1px solid #e6e0d4; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; list-style: none; } .ds-course li::before { display: inline-block; width: 5px; height: 5px; margin-right: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--rust); content: ""; }

components.css: .ds-faq { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; } .ds-faq-question { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 24px 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 500 18px/1.5 Poppins, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: color 250ms; } .ds-faq-question:hover { color: var(--rust-dark); } .ds-faq-question span { color: var(--rust); font-size: 20px; } .ds-faq-question:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--rust); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-faq-answer { max-width: 65ch; margin: 0; padding: 0 48px 24px 0; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; }

narrative.overview:
Warm, scholarly, and assured: the site presents Alpha Classes as a clear local prospectus rather than a generic coaching template. Poppins carries the voice; warm paper, ink navy, restrained rust, editorial columns, and measured rules give the existing content a consistent printed character.

The composition leaves generous unprinted space and uses flat surfaces instead of gradients or repeated raised cards. Photography acts as a printed plate, while the callback remains the primary action and phone and WhatsApp stay available.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and ink navy establish the reading field.
Rust is reserved for calls to action, small marks, and scroll progress.
Information is organized by columns, typography, and rules rather than card elevation.

rules.name: The Paper-First Rule
rules.body: Paper carries the long read; navy defines structure, and rust is reserved for action and indexing.

rules.name: The No-Card Rule
rules.body: Keep repeated information in editorial rows and rules instead of equal raised tiles.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Do not add shadows to ordinary sections, course entries, or form surfaces.

rules.name: The Soft-Corner Rule
rules.body: Round touchable controls and framed surfaces consistently; preserve the ruled course and testimonial rows instead of turning them into cards.

dos: Do use paper, ink navy, and restrained rust as the recurring palette.
Do use rules, columns, and whitespace to organize repeated content.
Do keep primary actions softly rounded and visibly keyboard-focusable.
Do preserve the existing course, proof, FAQ, location, and callback content.
donts: Don't introduce gradients or repeated raised-card grids.
Don't use shadows as the default way to separate sections.
Don't add new performance claims or rewrite existing testimonials.
